brief: For the cold-chain fulfillment center operated by a metropolitan public agency, plan a capacity upgrade while protecting service quality following unexpected demand increase. Baseline capacity: 1,190 units/day. Deliver at least 8.5% improvement within 3 months under CAD 866,000 capital limit; installation restricted to weekends. Select a technically justified alternative and test what happens if performance falls 15%.
